تكتمنون (form VIII)
# تَكْتَمِنُونَ (taktaminūna) /tak.ta.mi.nuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِكْتَمَنَ (iktamana)
# تُكْتَمَنُونَ (tuktamanūna) /tuk.ta.ma.nuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِكْتَمَنَ (iktamana)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
